_comment: Plugin manifest (authored by the plugin author). 'version' is the plugin semver (release-only); install-plugin reads 'setup'.
name: kaggle
description: Kaggle for Solaris agents through the official Kaggle CLI, CLI only: kaggle.py is a stdlib gateway that pins the CLI (kaggle==2.2.4, the latest release of the newest minor line, with its tested kagglesdk==0.1.37) and installs it separately into each project or ad-hoc task that uses it (<context>/.venv-kaggle, created on first call, rebuilt on a pin change, folder move or lost base Python; never global - at the bare framework root it runs from a throwaway uv environment); kaggle.skill.md routes agents to the gateway and to Kaggle's own agent skill, vendored unmodified from github.com/Kaggle/kaggle-cli tag v2.2.4 (kaggle-cli/SKILL.md + 12 command references) with field-verified 2.2.4 corrections, and covers OAuth sign-in, Solaris conventions and 401/403 triage; kaggle.rule.md is always-on: gateway only, every write to Kaggle (submit, push/update, create/version, metadata update, upload, benchmarks init/auth, host commands, delete, revoke) confirmed first, web-only steps (rules acceptance, teams, final picks) handed to the owner, credentials and minted keys never printed or committed, downloads kept in the context, Kaggle content treated as untrusted input.

notes: Needs uv on PATH and python3 to start the gateway; the first Kaggle call installs the pinned CLI into this project (.venv-kaggle/, git-ignored) - nothing is installed globally.

Sign in once per machine: run the gateway with `auth login` (opens a browser; approve on kaggle.com; credentials land in ~/.kaggle/ and serve every project). Accept each competition's rules on kaggle.com before downloading or submitting - the CLI cannot.
